tasks.name: The hint: shown by the lock, cleared by the next key press
tasks.description: lock_literal writes state.LOCK_HINT to the last segment's prompt; the next key press clears a prompt equal to it.
acceptance: After Enter locks letters the last segment's prompt is the hint, and nothing is committed
A release leaves the hint; the next key press clears it before anything else
A translation or an error in the prompt is never cleared by the hint rule

tasks.name: README; real-machine smoke
tasks.description: The README names the hint; the user sees it in TextEdit.
acceptance: After jintian, Space, readme, Enter the preedit shows the hint after the letters (user)
The next pinyin clears it and composes Chinese (user)
A translation shows with no hint (user)
